name: Func_080b211c

score.note: Correct byte count and matched 7-instruction prologue prefix, but the compiler's register allocator does not reproduce the reference's fp=shop/r9=item_count/stack-homed-unit_id assignment (candidate instead promotes unit_id into fp and shop into r9), which cascades into a differently-scheduled if(redraw) block and most of the body. Semantics were reconstructed with high confidence from the raw ROM bytes (own owner assembly disassembled directly from roms/gs1-en.gba, cross-checked against games/gs1/asm/080b211c.s) and cross-referenced against the near-identical sibling 080b1bd0 (shop/select_party_member.c family, template games/gs1/src/shop/select_sale_quantity.c and shop.h): both functions share an identical ~15-instruction prologue, the same nested for(;;) redraw/input-poll idiom as Shop_SelectPartyMember, and the same 5-column/15-slot inventory grid navigation (Modulo/FixedPoint_Ratio placement, wraparound decrement/increment on ADDR_03001B04 bits 0x20/0x10, and page up/down on bits 0x40/0x80). This owner's specific divergence from 080b1bd0: it calls Shop_ComputeRepairPrice (Func_080b20e8) instead of Shop_ComputeSalePrice, passes price_mode=2 instead of 1 to Shop_DrawItemPrice, and its post-confirm tail is a single unconditional Func_080b2328(unit_id, selection) call (no Shop_SelectSaleQuantity-style return check) followed by UiMessage_ShowAndWait((s32)&Value_00000cc2), verified against the exact literal-pool words extracted from the ROM (0x1ff mask, ADDR_03001F2C/ADDR_03001C94/ADDR_03001B04, +0x75 message-table base, 0xcc2 result message). Tried: (a) baseline direct translation -- wrong stack-frame size (sp,#20 vs #24) because unit_id was never spilled; (b) added dead item_count=1 init plus separated window/x/y locals (matching the sibling's own in-progress draft shape) -- fixed the frame size to 524/524 but did not fix the fp/r9 role swap; (c) extracted price into its own local -- no measurable effect; (d) gave Func_080b2328 a fake s32 return captured into price with a conditional -- made the match worse (536 vs 524 bytes). The sibling 080b1bd0's own in-progress draft has the identical fp/r9 register-role problem (its own candidate-show is also class=wrong, differing_halfwords=237), so this is evidence of a shared, currently-unsolved compiler register-allocation sensitivity for this two-nested-loop idiom rather than a defect specific to this file.

rejected_experiments.reason: Without a second dead-store-shaped local, the compiler keeps the unit_id parameter live in a register instead of spilling it to its stack home at entry, producing a 20-byte frame instead of the reference's 24-byte frame (differing_halfwords=217).

Declaring Func_080b2328 to return s32 and gating the follow-up UiMessage_ShowAndWait on it (mirroring the sibling's Shop_SelectSaleQuantity/-1 check) does not fix the fp/r9 register-role swap and adds instructions the real bytes do not have (536 vs 524 bytes, differing_halfwords=229).

notes: Recovered only from the retained owner assembly, approved local ROM, the byte-exact template/sibling sources, in-repository headers, and the approved compiler.
This candidate claims zero DONE bytes.

Confirmed via direct extraction from roms/gs1-en.gba (0x080b211c, 524 bytes) and arm-none-eabi-objdump --adjust-vma disassembly that games/gs1/asm/080b211c.s is a faithful pre-disassembled listing of the same bytes; used the raw extraction to resolve every PC-relative literal-pool word by address rather than guessing.

Diffed games/gs1/asm/080b211c.s against games/gs1/asm/080b1bd0.s: identical for the first ~30 instructions; diverges only in (1) Func_080b20e8 vs Func_080b19cc price computation, (2) price_mode operand 2 vs 1, (3) a single unconditional Func_080b2328(unit_id, selection) call in place of the sibling's Shop_SelectSaleQuantity call + -1 check + conditional Func_080b1f4c call, and (4) the trailing literal-pool message id (0x00000cc2 vs 0x00000caa).

shop.h already declares/macros Shop_PlaceCursor, Shop_DrawItemPrice, Shop_DrawMessage, Shop_ComputeRepairPrice, and BattleUnit_Get(unit_id)->inventory[15] at offset 0xd8, all reused here verbatim; Func_080b2328 and the Value_00000075/Value_00000cc2 address-trick constants have no established project name yet and were declared locally.

The sibling owner 080b1bd0 (same family, being reconstructed in parallel) already has a non-empty draft at games/gs1/recon/en/main/080b1bd0.c; its structure (declaration order, unit->inventory[selection] field access, separated window/x/y locals) was used as a cross-check, though its own Shop_DrawItemPrice call incorrectly reuses price_window instead of list_window for the first UiWindow_CreateFar result -- this file's own ROM-byte reading was trusted over that in-progress draft for that specific mapping.
